MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing: 
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.

They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have two power relays activated. These will be your targets as they cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective. 

Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

variants.briefing:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing: 
Regional analysis indicates that there is a suspected Shattered Blade hideout in an old QV Extraction station and Intersec is looking for a pilot to launch an attack against the station's power infrastructure.

This will be a multi-tiered assault, requiring you to target and destroy station components on the exterior and interior. From previous operations, we've learned that certain components cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, so ballistic or ordnance will be needed. Parts of the station have historically been flooded with heavy distortion energy, so you will need to act efficiently while inside.

These attacks are all an effort to allow you todestroy the now-exposed power core at the center.

The loss of this station will greatly impact the gang's ability to operate in the system and so has been deemed a high priority.

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station and ultimately get boots on the ground to save their pilot.

Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will need a variety of ship types to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions
